title: Graham Hancock's yage experience of a communicating presence

tellings.quote: in in every way and again this sense of a a presence and of and and of communication.

plain: The writer Graham Hancock says that while drinking yage, a hallucinogenic plant brew from the Amazon also known as ayahuasca, he felt a presence that was trying to communicate with him. He tells Michels this from his own experience, describing "this sense of a presence and of communication." If it is what he takes it to be, the brew would open a door to some other intelligence rather than just producing visions.
